1006.skill_description: Using the three-stage model (limited awareness, enhanced awareness and practice, lasting change) as the framework, systematically judge the stage the client is at. Through listening to clues such as emotion, resistance, externalization, patterns and countertransference, and combined with reflection, make trade-offs between supportive and uncovering interventions, emphasizing repeated practice and patience to bring about and consolidate the formation of new patterns.

720.skill_description: 指治疗师对来访者的情感总和,含有意识与without意识成分.觉察可减少not当外露,指导评估与Intervention,帮助理解来访者的人际模式及自我反应.Averagenot直接披露,需防平行过程与行动化破坏框架.

721.skill_description: Countertransference can be divided into two types, concordant and complementary: the former empathizes with and identifies with the client's affect or self state; the latter identifies with the attitudes of their significant others toward the client. The source can be distinguished by whether the reaction occurs only with this client.

722.skill_description: 治疗师Empathy或认同来访者的感受与内在状态,甚至感受其被Repression的情绪.此反应可提示来访者当前体验与防御,帮助选择支持或揭露的切入点.

723.skill_description: 治疗师not自觉地站在来访者重要他人的位置,体验对来访者的典型态度(如苛责,保护).有助于把握其关系模式,但需警惕将此态度行动化.

724.skill_description: 通过自我Questioning与回顾面谈时刻,留意对来访者的情感与异常行为(如说多说少,越矩举动,梦境).在督导或同伴讨论,比较你对督导的感受,以识do notCountertransference线索.

725.skill_description: 确认Countertransference后,评估其指向:来访者的显性/被Repression感受,正在发生的阻抗,还是与你自身历史相关.利用Anxiety等信号决定何时,如何Intervention与Confrontation,校准深度与时机.

726.skill_description: 通常not直接披露私人情感,而将其用于理解与Interpretation.必要时可适度表达:社会性回应,风险与安全建议,促进接触被Repression情感,培养心理化;同时注意边界与框架.

727.skill_description: 当行为偏离常态时,承认现实,探询来访者体验,并Reflection自身反应与动机,必要时带入督导.在not过度自我暴露前提下,利用行动化揭示关系动力并修复框架.

728.skill_description: When the client intuits that you are angry or affected, validate their feelings or conjecture, acknowledge errors and facts when necessary; in the uncovering mode continue exploring its meaning, in the supportive mode guide them to understand their own influence on others.

729.skill_name: Ask the client to imagine the counselor's feelings
729.skill_description: 通过邀请来访者设想你在其行为下的感受(如without故缺席),提升其对他人影响的觉察与心理化能力.以此为桥梁探讨人际模式,而非转向指责或过度自我披露.

730.skill_description: Use countertransference as a clue to choose supportive or uncovering intervention: when the alliance is fragile and vulnerability high, focus on support; as the relationship stabilizes and tolerance increases, gradually turn to confrontation and interpretation. Note dynamic adjustment with treatment progress.

1016.skill_description: Consultative session核心在于利用移情与Countertransference,通过支持或Uncovering interventionWorking through resistance与防御.旨在通过Freedom联想与梦的解析深入探索潜意识冲突,在反复修通中促进来访者深层领悟与人格改变.

310.skill_description: 三步法包括Listening,Reflection与Intervention.先以特殊方式Listening,再加工所听确定焦点与策略,最后实施言语或非言语Intervention并评估效果.

311.skill_description: 作为第一步,包含环绕,过滤,对焦三种模式;同时Listening言辞,语调与without声之处,灵活切换以捕捉情感,模式和without意识线索.

312.skill_description: not特意聚焦任何内容,开放接收全部材料,避免偏听漏听;常用于面谈开始阶段,帮助发现可能的重点与without意识线索.

313.skill_description: 从背景中筛选出重复主题或强烈情感,开始辨do not重要内容;注意not一致与模式中断,为后续对焦与Intervention铺垫.

314.skill_description: Focus attention on a specific topic or emotion, screening out most background noise; flexibly switch between the focus and the whole picture to keep capturing changes and new cues.

315.skill_description: 主动加工Listening到的信息以理解含意,决定聚焦与治疗策略;运用选择与准备原则,并整合理论与经验资源.

316.skill_description: 用于决定Intervention切入点:From surface to depth先选近意识材料;Following one's feelings以情感为线索;Attending to countertransference把握治疗师内在反应.

317.skill_description: 从接近意识,Anxiety较低的材料入手,逐层逼近更深层without意识,避免激发过强防御与抵抗,提高Intervention的可接受性.

318.skill_description: 以来访者当下最真实,最强烈的情感为导航,判断接近重要内容的路径,优先围绕情绪展开聚焦与Intervention.

319.skill_description: Notices the therapist's own emotional reactions, treating them as clues to understand the importance or emotional value of the material, and uses them to adjust focus and strategy.

320.skill_description: 评估来访者此刻的可用性与承受力:治疗同盟强度,治疗阶段,当下功能水平,以决定何时,以何深度Intervention.

321.skill_name: Evaluating the state of the therapeutic alliance
321.skill_description: Continuously assess the stability of mutual trust and cooperation; the stronger the alliance, the more the client can bear painful material; the alliance fluctuates with events and needs corresponding adjustment.

322.skill_description: Distinguishing the differences in acceptance across the beginning, middle, and ending stages; the middle stage is easier for exploring sensitive topics, the early stage focuses on structure and support, and the late stage focuses on ending issues.

323.skill_description: 关注压力,疾病等导致的功能波动;在退化时减少揭露性深度,改用支持性技术,确Security guard全与可用性.

324.skill_description: 治疗师以言语与非言语交流实施基础性,支持性或Uncovering intervention,并通过来访者反应评估效果,必要时调整策略.

325.skill_description: 贯穿所有治疗,旨在收集信息,结构化过程与表达理解;含指导与心理教育,Questioning,信息,Empathy,联想,Reflection与Silence.

326.skill_description: 说明治疗的做法与期待,TeachingFreedom联想,谈梦与情感,表达对治疗师的想法,提升来访者对治疗的利用与参与.

327.skill_description: Closed-ended to obtain specific facts; open-ended to guide in-depth description and emotional expansion. Avoid asking 'why', use more 'what' and 'how', promoting exploration.

328.skill_description: Provides information on appointments, fees, vacations, referrals, and medication; and attends to the relational meaning of information needs, to understand defense style and interaction patterns.

329.skill_description: 以Empathy话语传达理解与接纳,验证痛苦与努力;既能支持功能,也可作为揭露的起点,探索其潜在意义.

330.skill_description: 邀请就梦,事件与感受Freedom联想,增加自我觉察与材料广度;可用于支持性目标或深入探索without意识.

331.skill_description: 反馈与概括来访者的情绪与想法,让其校准与细化体验;促进Empathy式Listening与更准确的相互理解.

332.skill_description: 有意的Silence促使继续联想,放慢节奏或平复情绪;需依耐受度谨慎施用,以免引发过度Anxiety或Withdrawal.

333.skill_description: Support functions that are missing or weak, directly enhance function or behavior change; combine the providing type and the assisting type, flexibly adjusting according to the individual and the timing.

334.skill_description: Directly supply the currently missing functions, such as encouragement, naming, reorientation, soothing, protection, advice, structuring, and providing perspective, quickly stabilizing the state.

335.skill_description: Assist in using their own weak functions; through modeling, guidance, and cooperation set goals, test reality, solve problems, and organize planning, rebuilding capacity.

336.skill_description: 把without意识转化为意识的过程,通常经Confrontation,Clarification到Interpretation逐步推进;在充分准备时引入更深材料以增进洞察.

337.skill_description: Guide attention to phenomena such as pauses, slips of the tongue, or topic shifts, arousing curiosity and prompting the client to explore the feelings and meanings behind them, opening the uncovering process.

338.skill_description: 把重复出现的现象与时间点联系起来,辨识模式并Questioning熟悉感,使without意识内容进入视野,为Interpretation铺路.

339.skill_description: 以假设性语言连接行为或情绪与without意识因素的因果,必要时拓展为遗传Interpretation,帮助来访者获得洞察.

772.skill_description: 以Listening,Reflection与Intervention为路径,系统识do notwithout意识Fantasy,冲突与Defense mechanisms,循序揭露与支持,降低Anxiety,促进更灵活的防御与更健康的人际功能.

773.skill_description: 指停驻于without意识中的愿望或Fear,短小且带孩童色彩,驱动行为并Shaping防御;相关集合称'情结'.揭露可减轻羞耻,促进自我理解与更自主的选择.

774.skill_description: Capture the 'story behind the story' in the narration, think about what the client wants or fears at this moment; pay attention to childish wishes and anomalous clues; high-functioning individuals are more concealed, requiring careful listening for recurring themes.

775.skill_description: 将主导Fantasy概括为一两句话,判断其类型(愿望,Fear或自我看法),评估与主导情感的联系;择取贴近表层者,为后续Confrontation,Clarification与Interpretation做准备.

776.skill_description: 遵循选择与准备原则,慢启动,优先处理临近表层的内容;以Confrontation—Clarification—Interpretation链条逐步引入意识,兼顾安全与同盟,避免加深阻抗与Anxiety.

777.skill_description: 在安全情境中帮助来访者意识核心Fantasy,减少羞耻,增进理解与选择空间;过程缓慢谨慎,以Questioning,Confrontation与Clarification铺垫适时的Interpretation.

778.skill_description: 指出叙述中的not一致或遗漏,聚焦当下细节,使隐匿的愿望或Fear浮出表层,如'你not说你喜欢它';以轻柔方式trigger觉察而非防御升级.

779.skill_description: 在多次对话中梳理重复情境与核心期待,明确真正困扰点(如'not是他not做,而是他not自己想到'),为接受Interpretation奠定语义与情感基础.

780.skill_description: 将显性行为与隐性愿望以因果图式联结,命名'核心Fantasy',并与当前情感相印证;在可承受时提出,促其在现实中作更灵活的选择.

781.skill_description: 对立的without意识Fantasy相碰撞所致,产生Anxiety并trigger防御;若长期not yet解,会僵化功能与关系.Interpretation冲突可减Anxiety,促采用更成熟,适应性的防御.

782.skill_description: 如找'烟'的消防员般围绕Anxiety线索Listening;留意情感突变,not一致,口误与梦境等,由此追踪表层之下的对立Fantasy与正在运作的防御.

783.skill_description: 关注与Anxiety相关的言语与行为:治疗室中的坐立not安,激动,看表;治疗外的Sleep and eating problems,敏感,拖延,冲动,判断力下降及Anxiety梦.

784.skill_description: 任何情感的显著改变(易怒,抑郁心境,心情突然高涨)都可能是冲突与Anxiety的线索;将其与当下情境比对,以定位对立Fantasy的活跃点.

785.skill_description: 识do not体验与情感,情感与想法,想法与想法之间的not匹配,如喜庆时落泪,想起爱人却抑郁,互相矛盾计划,提示深层冲突在运作.

786.skill_description: 当被Repression的思绪或情感跃出口时形成口误,如把'老板'说成'爸爸';此类失误常指向早期关系中的Fantasy与当前冲突的关联通道.

787.skill_description: Anxiety性的梦常标示冲突存在;探索与Interpretation梦境,有助于识do not主导Fantasy及其对立面,为理解症状与选择Intervention焦点提供线索.

788.skill_description: 提炼对立Fantasy两极,梳理与主导情感的连接;分层评估表层到深层材料,优先选取'轻推可入意识'的部分,避免trigger过强阻抗.

789.skill_description: 在同盟允许下,以Confrontation—Clarification—Interpretation逐步揭露冲突;必要时纳入遗传或移情脉络,帮助整合与选择更适应的防御,缓解Anxiety与症状.

790.skill_description: 使冲突进入意识并得以思考,减少麻痹与病理化防御;谨慎推进,先以Questioning与Clarification靠近,再于情感就绪时给出Interpretation.

791.skill_description: Directly point out the dilemma and tug in words and deeds (such as 'half wants to tell, half wants to conceal'), lock onto the conflict core, prompting them to pause and observe their own opposite motives and consequences.

792.skill_description: 梳理冲突成分与trigger情境,区分愿望与Fear的轨迹,连接当下与反复出现的模式,使问题结构化,便于后续Interpretation与整合.

793.skill_description: 给出因果图式,联系对立Fantasy,Anxiety与防御,并可引入移情与早期经验;在可承受范围内提出,助其形成新的理解与选择.

794.skill_description: Anxietytrigger的心理策略,用以保护自我免受not适情感与冲突;可带来首要获益与次要获益,但需付出代价,适应性水平与人际影响各异.

795.skill_description: 把阻抗视为防御在场信号,留意语塞,Silence,迟到等;随治疗推进识do not个性化防御组合与时机,为选择支持或揭露性技术提供依据.

796.skill_description: 确认主导防御,评估其适应性与'代价',决定Reinforcement或替换;结合同盟与阶段,挑选最破坏性且贴近表层者作为优先Intervention目标.

797.skill_description: 两条路径并行:支持性—Reinforcement成熟防御,建议低代价替代;揭露性—使防御进入意识以重选策略.始终缓慢,尊重,避免骤然拆防.

798.skill_description: 遵循'慢慢开始',以Questioning,联想Demands与Empathy性表述促使细节展开;在nottrigger过强Anxiety前提下,收集线索并靠近表层without意识内容.

799.skill_description: 用开放式问题Guidance复现场景与念头,丰富细节,帮助without意识线索靠近意识,如'那时你在想什么?'为后续Clarification与Interpretation铺路.

800.skill_description: 在功能脆弱时优先use,确认并Reinforcement适应性防御,检验现实,提供表扬与建议,帮助以更低代价方式管理情绪和冲突,减少人际损害.

801.skill_description: 第一步是轻柔地引起对问题性防御或行为的注意,命名其模式与时机,帮助来访者在not过度羞愧的情况下看见并承认它的存在.

802.skill_description: The second step points out the negative consequences this defense brings, such as alienation, ridicule, or relationship damage; let the client assess gains and losses, building a bridge for change motivation and alternative plans.

803.skill_description: 第三步共同探索更健康,代价更小的选择,如现实检验,Sublimation,利他等;以Empathy与表扬支持尝试,巩固新防御的use.

804.skill_description: 当同盟稳固且材料在表层时,循序Confrontation—Clarification—Interpretation,使without意识防御变得可思考;目标是灵活运用而非消灭防御,降低僵化与代价.

805.skill_description: When emotionally ready, point out the present manifestations and cycles of defenses such as avoidance and distancing, prompting them to pause automatic reactions; tone respectful, avoiding humiliation and disintegration.

806.skill_description: 细化防御出现的情境,功能与trigger点,串联跨时段实例,分辨其短期收益与长期代价,为接受Interpretation与尝试替代做认知准备.

807.skill_description: 说明该防御如何保护其免受羞耻与Fear,同时带来关系或现实的损失;强调目的在于扩充选择与成熟度,而非剥夺其Self-protection.

340.skill_description: 以情感主导原则为指引,始终贴近来访者显性与隐性的情绪,将情感作为进入without意识的通道,既用于诊断与理解,也用于提升情绪调节能力与治疗效能.

341.skill_description: 围绕主导情感Listening:辨do not表达与内容是否匹配,情感是否缺失,强度是否过或not及,观察会谈内外行为与情绪变化,以捕捉显性或隐性的核心感受.

342.skill_description: After listening, use the principles of selection and preparation, in combination with the stage, the alliance, and functioning, to judge which affect to focus on: first empathize with the surface, oppressive emotions, or, when the relationship is solid, explore the deeper feelings that are defended against.

343.skill_description: 围绕情感的Intervention分为基础性,支持性与揭露性:先以心理教育,指导,Questioning与Empathy建立焦点,再在失衡时支持调节,或在条件成熟时揭示without意识情感.

344.skill_description: 以心理教育,指导,Questioning与Empathy为起点,帮助来访者识do nottrigger,命名体验并被理解,作为支持性或Interpretation性Work的平台,安全地引向更深的情感探索.

345.skill_description: 以简明Interpretation连接行为与情感(如暴饮暴食与not适情绪),提供信息与具体建议,帮助来访者理解情绪—行为链条并形成更适应的应对与选择.

346.skill_description: 以温和,without评判的方式准确映照来访者的痛苦与脆弱(如'那一定很难熬'),传达关心与理解,降低羞耻与防御,促进情感表露与进一步探讨.

347.skill_description: 通过开放式Questioning聚焦情感与trigger点(如'之前你有什么感受?'),Guidance来访者识do not,细化并连接情绪与经历,为管理情感与Interpretation性Work铺路.

348.skill_description: 当来访者被强烈情绪淹not时,目标是化解或接纳hard to bear的情感,并提升自我安抚与调节能力,减少以self-injury,物质等方式应对的风险与依赖.

349.skill_description: Use direct, immediate provision techniques (naming emotions, caring and soothing, dispelling doubts, verification, and so on) to help the client rapidly reduce amplitude, move from loss of control to an expressible state, and create safety for subsequent exploration.

350.skill_description: 把模糊,威胁性的体验转化为可言说的情感词汇(如伤心,愤怒,羞耻),以标定与界定情绪,增强可控感并促进自我观察与进一步Reflection.

351.skill_description: 以Empathy,表扬,鼓励与希望等方式提供情感性抚慰与支持,示范冷静与调节,缓解内疚与羞耻,帮助来访者从高唤起过渡到可Reflection的状态.

352.skill_description: 通过正常化与安抚性说明(如'你并not yet发疯')减少灾难化与自责,重建安全与信心,为Learning替代性应对与继续探索情感扫清心理障碍.

353.skill_description: Validate the client's emotions and situation and reality-test them, confirm the reasonableness of the feelings and clarify the facts, reducing confusion and self-blame, letting the experience settle, and supporting more effective self-regulation and choices.

354.skill_description: 在治疗关系中以稳定,包容的姿态承载强烈情绪,部分以非言语方式传达接纳,并将not yet成形体验付诸言语,必要时Supportively avoid extreme emotions to safeguard functioning.

355.skill_description: 旨在使without意识情感进入意识,用情感理解其他without意识内容,并追溯消极情感的来源;常以Confrontation,Clarification,Interpretation逐步推进,尤其在同盟稳固时应用.

356.skill_description: Demands来访者正视被忽略或缺失的情绪,直面主导感受以促进表述与探索,如指出语义模糊与行为后果的not一致,激活对情感的注意与表达.

357.skill_description: 连接分散片段与重复模式,指出模糊用语与情境间的联系,含移情脉络下的规律性,从而为Interpretationwithout意识动机与防御提供更清晰的框架.

358.skill_description: 在充分线索基础上指出回避情绪的without意识动机与防御(如与父母区分的认同),帮助来访者理解情感—历史的关联,逐步修通与情绪的联系.

610.skill_description: Transference analysis is the core task of understanding all the client's feelings toward the therapist. Through it, it reveals the client's relational patterns with significant others, assesses the intervention timing for support or exposure, repairs the alliance, and provides an entry point for exploring memories and conflicts. In the support mode, transference can be contained and limited; in the exposure mode, insight and choice are promoted through interpretation.

611.skill_description: 通过将移情分门do not类(情感,过去人际,置换),为理解,记录与讨论提供框架,帮助识do not来源与功能,指导后续Listening,Reflection与Intervention的选择,提高治疗一致性.

612.skill_description: 按情感识do not移情为积极与消极.积极移情(信任,理想化,情爱等)支持同盟,除非过度需处理;消极移情(愤怒,嫉妒,羞辱等)应追溯来源,避免危害治疗.

613.skill_description: 来访者把早期重要他人的体验'好像'Projection到治疗师上,包括母性,父性,同胞移情,以及二元/三元发展模式.理解其来源有助于处理羞耻,依恋与竞争等主题.

614.skill_description: When direct transference is too strong, the affect is displaced onto a third party or situation. Listening to evaluations and stories about others can capture clues, and returning to the treatment relationship to examine its meaning related to the therapist promotes awareness and reality testing.

615.skill_description: Consciously listen for transference clues: grasp impromptu speech, details of entering and leaving the room, comments about others, repeated interpersonal scripts, and your countertransference. Record the clues, laying a basis and timing judgment for subsequent reflection and intervention.

616.skill_description: 识do not对移情意识的阻抗:来访者deny与治疗师相关,将情感视为'真实',或以一种情感遮蔽另一种.留意语言与非言语信号,为心理教育与Supportive intervention做准备.

617.skill_description: 在Listening中识do not移情类do not:积极/消极,母性/父性/同胞,二元/三元,以及置换.分类有助于框定讨论,与督导沟通,并选择适当的支持或揭露性技术.

618.skill_description: After noticing the clues, assess whether the client is ready, the current importance, the timing of interpretation, whether to explore the substitute first or the transference directly, and whether to encourage awareness or uncover. Guard against transference storms, ensure reality testing and safety, and maintain the alliance.

619.skill_description: Choose interventions according to the client's functioning and alliance: basic (psychoeducation, questioning), supportive (containment and repair), or uncovering (confrontation, clarification, interpretation). Balance intensity and timing to avoid overwhelming a fragile client.

620.skill_description: 以教育与结构化Questioning帮助来访者理解什么是移情,为何讨论对治疗有益,承认其not适,逐步建立在治疗中谈论对治疗师感受的能力,为后续Work打基础.

621.skill_description: 在治疗早期Notes:讨论你对我的想法与感受能揭示人际模式.Empathy其困难,重复强调其价值;当not适出现时,将其理解为阻抗并温和鼓励继续探索.

622.skill_description: Use concrete, time-limited questions to probe the transference, such as 'What feelings do you have about my being late?' and 'How did you experience the cancellation of the session?', prompting the externalization of affect and collecting information to provide material for clarification and interpretation.

623.skill_description: 在功能脆弱或移情强烈时,以支持性策略减少干扰,维系同盟:从移情中Learning但not刻意关注,直接反馈治疗中的行为,修复,包容并缓冲敌对反应.

624.skill_description: Encourage the client to describe the feelings and assumptions toward the therapist at this moment, compare the differences with reality, enhance psychological awareness and reality testing, and thereby correct mistaken expectations of others and improve interpersonal interaction outside.

625.skill_description: Turn emotions into language and label them accurately, such as 'you feel neglected or irritated'. Naming can reduce emotional intensity, help manage the transference, and provide a common reference for validation, interpretation, and relationship repair.

626.skill_description: When the client's feelings point to a real event, validate their experience and apologize; with the permission of the alliance, gently correct erroneous perceptions, openly interpret the facts, jointly test reality, reduce distortion and hostility, and stabilize the treatment relationship.

627.skill_description: Help the client distinguish the subjective experiences of self and others, imagine other possibilities, describe the experience in treatment, compare self-evaluation with the therapist's observation, promote self-reflection and relational understanding, and reduce paranoid transference.

628.skill_description: 在not防御的态度下温和纠偏,对具体言行进行Clarification与道歉,邀请来访者Jointly testing reality,减少对治疗师的歪曲印象,修复裂痕并保护治疗同盟.

629.skill_description: 适度分享你当下的主观感受与反应,以示你有独立的心智与体验,支持来访者心理觉察并区分Projection与现实,同时维持界限,防止过度自我暴露.

630.skill_description: 当来访者功能稳健或人际困扰需探索时,useUncovering intervention:Confrontation使情感入意识,Clarification跨情境模式,Interpretation将反应与without意识或过去关系相连,促成洞察与选择.

631.skill_description: 以直接陈述或QuestioningGuidance来访者注意到对治疗师的情感与反应,特do not在其接近表层时use,Confrontation后继续探索细节,使移情从暗处进入可讨论的意识.

632.skill_description: 指出来访者在not同情境或时间对治疗师的重复反应,连接片段为模式,增强其对移情的确信与可见性,为进一步Interpretation提供稳定的素材与语境.

633.skill_description: 两类Interpretation:将当前行为视为without意识移情的结果,或将移情与早期Interpersonal relationships相连.Interpretation促进对自我与他人关系的洞察,帮助来访者做出新的应对选择.

359.skill_description: Freedom联想Demands来访者not加Editor地说出所思所感,借心理决定论追随思路以接近without意识.阻抗为阻碍联想与治疗进展的任何言行,是定位'哪里受伤了'的线索,可有意识亦可without意识.

360.skill_description: 以均衡停靠式注意跟随来访者的联想旅程,聆听思想,情感与记忆的连接,并留意打断,Silence或转题等线索.without论支持性或揭露性取向,此种Listening均是进入without意识Work的基础.

361.skill_description: 在会谈中持续跟随来访者的联想流,假设念头间以有意义方式相连,借此由意识通向without意识.避免过早Guidance或筛选内容,允许'漫游',以把握关键联结与隐匿主题.

362.skill_name: 识do not联想中断中的阻抗
362.skill_description: 将任何阻碍Freedom联想的现象视为潜在阻抗:Silence,迟疑,迅速转题,思路丢失等.捕捉中断的时点与情境,温和探询其含义,以定位难以进入意识的内容与相关防御.

363.skill_description: 识do not阻抗后,评估是否,何时以及如何引起来访者注意,兼顾治疗阶段,同盟与来访者功能.防止显得苛责,记住阻抗指向'痛点',在支持与揭露之间拿捏时机与深度.

364.skill_description: Center hypotheses and verification on the causes and functions of resistance, perceive its protective significance, and judge in combination with surface material, the dominant affect, and countertransference. Common sources include fear, loss, guilt, shame, and therapist errors, so as to choose the corresponding techniques.

365.skill_description: 来访者惧怕改变或Unknown,维持熟悉而曾经适应的方式,回避消极感受与冲突表达.表现为过度迎合,过度积极或避免矛盾话题等.理解其Fear有助于Empathy并调整Intervention力度.

366.skill_description: 改变意味放弃既得满足或关系中的隐性收益,引发真实或想象的丧失体验.来访者或固守旧模式以避免'失去',如重复错误以维系补偿.识do not丧失主题有助于规划支持.

367.skill_description: without意识内疚促使来访者以症状或失败进行'补偿',以免感到超越他人的负疚.因此可能抗拒改善或进步.探索内疚来源与Fantasy,帮助其在not自我破坏的前提下承受修复.

368.skill_description: 对without意识欲望,Fear或Fantasy的羞耻体验促使回避披露与加工,尤其在性与身份主题中显著.以敏感,非评判态度降低羞耻,逐步拓展可谈论的边界,避免过早逼近.

369.skill_description: 误解,Empathy失败或疏忽(如迟到)可trigger抵制与退避.先自我监测Countertransference,检视关系破裂的贡献因素,必要时修复再Work;勿将来访者反应仓促归因于其防御.

370.skill_description: 根据目标与来访者准备度选择Intervention:基础性技术用于促进联想与信息获取;支持性技术接纳或重塑阻抗以维持功能;揭露性技术旨在把握阻抗含义,联系without意识并减少其阻碍.

371.skill_description: 通过心理教育,Questioning,指导与Empathy,促进畅所欲言,获取细节并降低初始Anxiety.温和提示在Silence时描述所思所感,为后续支持或揭露性Work打下信息与同盟基础.

372.skill_description: 在治疗早期InterpretationFreedom联想的重要性与方法,鼓励尽可能畅所欲言;以温和提示Guidance开场与Silence时的表达,明确可谈话题(感受,梦,对治疗的想法),降低新手的not适.

373.skill_description: 体察并言语化来访者在尝试联想与接触痛苦内容时的尴尬与Anxiety,以非评判态度承接其防御.Empathy可缓冲Uncovering intervention的威胁,增强安全感与合作,促进更真实的表达.

374.skill_description: Around resistance and plot details, raise open and specific questions to help the client expand the narration and focus on key events. Question design is oriented toward obtaining workable material, avoiding leading and judgment, serving understanding rather than conclusions.

375.skill_description: 当出现阻抗迹象(如忘记付费,记not住梦)时,邀请来访者就其现象Freedom联想与联结,以将注意力转向防御背后的意义.此举常开启更深加工,帮助进入相关情感与记忆.

376.skill_description: When direct uncovering may destroy functioning, choose to accept or redirect the resistance, helping adopt more adaptive protective means and reducing obstruction to the goals. Attendance, compliance, and emotion regulation can be improved through structured advice and reality guidance.

377.skill_description: For resistance interfering with treatment (lateness, missed appointments, concealment, etc.), on the premise of maintaining the alliance, provide reality-oriented advice and guidance, improve operable behaviors and environmental conditions; when necessary, postpone uncovering and prioritize stability and functional recovery.

378.skill_description: Propose feasible strategies for specific hindering factors (such as adjusting travel, setting reminders, switching to taxis) to reduce harm to work time and effectiveness from lateness and missed appointments. The focus is on functional improvement rather than interpreting motivation, in a pragmatic and supportive tone.

379.skill_description: 在内容过于激发时进行温和重定向,暂避强迫性或压倒性材料,转向可承受的主题与情感;或提示会谈结构与目标,帮助保持参与并降低Anxiety,为后续深入创造条件.

380.skill_description: 以理解阻抗的without意识含义为目标,运用Confrontation,Clarification与Interpretation逐步Guidance觉察.把握时机与语气,先Empathy其保护功能,再假设可能联系,以减少阻抗对not yet来Work的干扰.

381.skill_description: Gently point out observable resistance phenomena (such as silence, topic shifting, lateness), invite the client to be curious together about their occurrence and timing; or point out disconnections in the associations, to test their readiness. The tone is exploratory, avoiding blame and labeling.

382.skill_description: 将多次,看似without关的阻抗片段并置,指向其可能的共同主题或联系,促进来访者自我观察与联结.保持探询而非断言的姿态,使without意识轮廓在相似性中逐渐浮现.

383.skill_description: 在Confrontation与Clarification基础上,提出对阻抗without意识动机的假设,并与当下情境,历史经验相连.语气试探且Empathy,强调可能性并征询反应,以避免威胁其防御并深化加工.

916.skill_description: 在心理动力学治疗中,Dream interpretation以Manifest dream content与联想为线索,借首要过程的加工还原隐性内容,帮助理解without意识的情感,Fantasy与移情,是探索心灵的重要技术.

917.skill_description: 区分Manifest dream content(可叙述的故事)与Latent dream content(without意识内容),理解白日遗思与梦工厂(压缩,替换,象征)如何将隐性转为显性,为后续Work定向.

918.skill_description: 指来访者能记住并讲述的梦的故事.先环绕式Listening,再聚焦清晰元素,情绪与主题,用其作为启动联想与接近without意识的入口,而非直接'解码'.

919.skill_description: 指隐藏于显性故事背后的without意识情感,愿望,Fantasy与关系表征.通过联想并把握压缩,替换,象征等首要过程,逐步还原其意义并用于Interpretation.

920.skill_description: 同时Listening梦境叙述与其前后所有言谈作为联想,关注心境,清晰要点,主题与与面谈节点的联系,以定位最接近表层的线索与合适的Intervention点.

921.skill_description: 在'沐浴'梦境中思考元素表征的without意识情感,Fear与Fantasy,结合重复与情感强度,并依准备与选择原则决定何时,以何种方式推进Intervention.

922.skill_description: 两个相关对象或观念在without意识中合并成一个显性元素,提示多重来源与联系.识do not压缩有助于追溯关键关系与情感,为Clarification与Interpretation提供线索.

923.skill_description: Manifest elements symbolize wishes, fears, interpersonal representations, or self-perceptions in the latent content. Understanding symbolism must rely on the individual's associations, so be careful to avoid 'one-to-one' decoding and to grasp its appropriateness in conjunction with the context.

924.skill_description: 依据Ego functions与Anxiety耐受,在基础性,支持性与揭露性之间选择.先以教育与Questioning启动联想;必要时规避;条件成熟时Confrontation,Clarification并提出Interpretation.

925.skill_description: 通过心理教育与开放式Questioning帮助来访者理解梦的价值与Work方法,强调联想重于剧情意义,降低困惑与Withdrawal,促进入手,聚焦与素材生成.

926.skill_description: 告知梦可通向without意识;记住并谈论任何梦都有效;not必立刻'懂得意义'.Work重点是对元素作联想而非故事本身,以提升参与与安全感.

927.skill_description: With open questions and follow-up questions about emotions and images promote association, such as 'what did you feel in the dream?'; when key elements are omitted, give moderate guidance, and pay attention to the clues to resistance behind the omissions.

928.skill_description: 当深入探索或揭露可能加重Anxiety与混乱时,优先采用支持性方式:Empathy,安抚,现实检验,并用显性元素连结当下困扰,暂缓深挖以稳固自我.

929.skill_description: 在可承受范围内,温和邀请围绕梦的画面,词语与情绪作Freedom联想,优先靠近表层与安全主题,既获取线索,又避免trigger过度Anxiety或去现实.

930.skill_description: 当来访者脆弱或not愿深谈梦时,尊重回避,以Supportive avoidance替代揭露;以Empathy,验证与替代性Interpretation减压,待功能Recovery后再探索without意识内容.

931.skill_description: 在同盟稳固,耐受充分时,围绕梦的without意识假设推进Work,经由Confrontation与Clarification累积材料,提出Interpretation,促进情感进入意识并深化移情与冲突理解.

932.skill_description: 为吸引注意与激发好奇,点出梦中的特定元素或Displacement而not预设意义,如'你的梦里为何出现那只蓝色大鸟?'以促发进一步联想与探索.

933.skill_description: 指出梦的元素与重复出现的情境或联想之间的关系,帮助识do not模式与节点,搭建Interpretation的语境,使without意识线索更加接近表层,便于进一步Work.

934.skill_description: 在充分联想与Clarification基础上,提出对without意识基础的假设,将象征,压缩与关系表征整合成意义,促进情感识do not与Symptom improvement,避免生硬跳步.

935.skill_description: 当来访者提到梦却Displacement或迟迟not谈时,温和指出并探询其原因,同时记住紧随其后的内容也可能是联想;把握时机,not急迫也not忽视阻抗.
